
######  Input Parameter of Standard Intarface  ######

  Open Standard-Mode Inputfile StdFace.def 

  KEYWORD : model                | VALUE : Hubbard 
  KEYWORD : lattice              | VALUE : wannier90 
  KEYWORD : w                    | VALUE : 2 
  KEYWORD : l                    | VALUE : 2 
  KEYWORD : ncond                | VALUE : 4 
  KEYWORD : 2sz                  | VALUE : 0 
  KEYWORD : doublecounting       | VALUE : bogus 

#######  Construct Model  #######

    CDataFileHead = zvo         ######  DEFAULT VALUE IS USED  ######
           phase0 = 0.00000     ######  DEFAULT VALUE IS USED  ######
           phase1 = 0.00000     ######  DEFAULT VALUE IS USED  ######
           phase2 = 0.00000     ######  DEFAULT VALUE IS USED  ######

  @ Super-Lattice setting

                L = 2         
                W = 2         
           Height = 1           ######  DEFAULT VALUE IS USED  ######
   Number of Cell = 4

  @ Wannier90 Geometry 

    Wannier90 Geometry file = zvo_geom.dat
    Number of Correlated Sites = 1
    Direct lattice vectors:
         1.00000    0.00000    0.00000
         0.00000    1.00000    0.00000
         0.00000    0.00000    1.00000
    Wannier centres:
         0.00000    0.00000    0.00000
         lambda_U = 1.00000     ######  DEFAULT VALUE IS USED  ######
         lambda_J = 1.00000     ######  DEFAULT VALUE IS USED  ######
